title: Automated INT8 weight-only profile integration and long-run regression test
creator: Arielle Chen
description:
Background:
We need to integrate INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ and AWQ variants) into our CI/regression pipeline to catch accuracy regressions and runtime performance changes before they hit staging. Current work on weight-only quantization has focused on offline calibration artifacts and ad-hoc evals; this ticket builds a repeatable, automated path that exercises profile generation, model variant selection, and downstream scorer/eval integration at scale.

Goals:
- Add end-to-end CI coverage for generating INT8 weight-only profiles for target model families (e.g., LlamaX, Red-Base) using both GPTQ and AWQ flows.
- Run nightly long-run regression jobs that measure accuracy (QA pass rates, Rouge/BLEU where applicable, log-prob deltas) and runtime metrics (tokens/sec, p99 latency, memory) across profiles.
- Surface clear pass/fail criteria and automatic alerts for regression (quality drop > 2% absolute vs baseline OR latency increase > 15%).
- Provide an automated rollback/playbook reference for any profile-induced production incidents.

Success criteria / Acceptance criteria:
- CI job 'int8-weightonly-profile-regtest' produces profiles and artifacts deterministically for a stable seed in <= 2 hours for small models and completes in <= 6 hours for large models.
- Nightly job writes formal metrics to the eval dashboard and creates a GitHub issue on regression rules being triggered.
- Canary on dedicated infra with profile enabled shows no more than 1.5% quality drift on baseline prompts in 48h smoke window.
- Playbook link present in the CI job output; on fail will trigger alert channel and create a PagerDuty incident if customer_impact is high.

Plan / Implementation steps:
1) CI harness: extend quant-profile CI runner to include weight-only GPTQ and AWQ pipelines (dockerized steps). Use deterministic seeds and fixed calibration datasets. (owner: Marco)
2) Baselines: capture golden logits/outputs for a small canonical prompt set (50 prompts) and a larger regression corpus (5k prompts). Store in s3 folder 'quant-baselines/int8-weightonly/'. (owner: Arielle)
3) Metrics and thresholds: implement automatic comparison tool that computes top-k accuracy, average log-prob delta, token-level perplexity, p99 latency and tokens/sec. Thresholds stored as YAML in repo. (owner: QA)
4) Long-run nightlies: schedule multi-day runs with coverage across model sizes and kernels; output aggregated report and push to dashboard and create summary PR. (owner: Infra)
5) Regression gating: wire results to create GitHub issues when thresholds break and to mark PRs with 'quant-fail' label preventing merges if critical. (owner: CI infra)
6) Playbook: document rollback steps (revert profile, switch to FP16 variant, route to fallback model) and measure impact. (owner: SRE)

Test plan / Datasets / Harness details:
- Calibration datasets: 'calib-small-v1' (1000 sequences), 'calib-large-v1' (20k sequences) sampled from internal production logs (PII scrubbed).
- Eval datasets: 'regset-5k' curated for safety/edge cases; 'smoke-50' for quick local runs.
- Hardware matrix: test on A100-80GB, A100-40GB, and H100 nodes with both CUDA and ROCm where available.
- Determinism: seed all random ops and document non-deterministic steps; if non-deterministic across runs, add retry logic and record variance.

Rollout and mitigation:
- Start in CI only (no production usage) for 1 week. If stable, enable canary on dedicated pool (5% traffic) for 48h. On regression, automatic fallback to existing FP16 variant and create incident.

Artifacts / Links:
- Confluence PRD: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/973212/INT8+Weight-Only+Profile+Integration
- Design notes: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/example-quant-designs
- Golden baseline bucket: s3://redwood-quant-baselines/int8-weightonly/
- CI runner repo (prototype): https://github.com/redwood-inference/quant-ci/tree/feature/int8-weightonly
- Dashboard panel: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/quant-int8-regressions

Risks / Open questions:
- AWQ vs GPTQ output divergences: define how to reconcile when the two algorithms disagree on a suggested profile. Proposal: prefer lower-latency profile unless quality drop > threshold.
- Storage and cost of long-run artifacts; consider TTL or compression.
- ROCm support maturity for some kernels; coordinate with runtime team for kernel fallbacks.

Notes on uniqueness: this ticket focuses on automated integration and long-run nightly/regression gating (not one-off calibration), and includes canary/rollback playbook and explicit alerting rules to prevent profile regressions from reaching production.
